body:
Codex consolidated adversarial review, with two independent read-only reviewers: ADR 0001 remains Proposed and the M1 source beads should stay closed. The architecture is close and the adapter boundary is good; the following are bounded changes, but five are scientific or contractual blockers.

P0-1 anchor versus fidelity. A role reversal, polarity flip, context shift, modality error, or wrong outcome can still be recall of the correct source event. Excluding the source node converts distortion into omission plus intrusion and contradicts the NPA model. Factor inference into source-anchor admissibility and conditional fidelity modes. A contradiction may exclude Faithful(ref), while Distorted(ref, facets) remains available. The invariant should be: once a state-mode pair is explicitly inadmissible, no score or refinement can resurrect that mode. Context is a fidelity facet, not an external-state gate. Remove the public production gating flag; GraphHsmm should own the non-optional mode gate, with ungated behavior confined to an explicit ablation API.

P0-2 embedding identity and result algebra. Split static Model or ProviderFingerprint from a per-recipe EmbeddingSpace or GeometryId containing role, view, instruction digest, dimension, normalization, and truncation. Query and document spaces require a validated compatibility pair. Use smart unique RequestIds and a checked BatchResult. Remove duplicate abstention representations: valid absence is Estimate.Missing; execution failure is separate. A preflight denial or cache hit cannot truthfully carry a ProviderCall, so return an attempt or batch receipt with zero or more provider calls plus policy and cache decisions.

P0-3 enforceable privacy. Separate remote-safe PseudonymizedText from a separately held ReidentificationKey. Raw text requests and authorized remote requests must be different types or APIs; only policy evaluation can construct the latter. Add a sensitivity-aware digest and typed embedding receipt rather than hiding HMAC semantics in ordinary Checksum or ProviderCall params. Bind capability to provider, model, purpose, policy, expiry, budget, and exact sanitized payload; sanitize errors and logs.

P0-4 structural estimand availability. Current RecallUnit, NodeSummary, and AlignmentSource expose sketches, not checked proposition charts, so the promised grakern d_prop is not implementable. Add an explicit PropositionEvidence channel for recall and source charts, returning Missing when absent. Keep sketch compatibility as a distinct fallback; do not label it AMR or grakern structural distance. Define d_chart, d_wl, and d_sem separately, or specify their lawful composition.

P0-5 independent evaluation. Synthetic or machine-built material is diagnostic only. Freeze source charts, hierarchy, summaries, acceptable target sets, alternatives, and external labels independently of every tested feature. The locked selection set needs full adjudication and a natural human-recall panel; ten percent audit and a different generator do not remove circularity. Use story-family development, calibration, and untouched test partitions. Reserve calibrated for outputs fitted against adjudicated targets; otherwise say benchmark-tuned or raw.

Required P1 hardening: preserve each candidate nomination with channel, rank, raw score, space, and receipt; use validated distances rather than clamping invalid doubles; make vector dimension and normalization typed; key caches by exact rendered provider material and full recipe; include document/support/tokenizer/window/pooling/coverage in late-pooling identity; treat Matryoshka truncations as derived re-normalized spaces; fingerprint TF-IDF corpus and hashed-ngram seed/function/dimension.

Evaluation must report strict acceptable-target recall at declared level, level confusion, segment-summary accuracy, blend set coverage, candidate burden, MRR, and story-macro confidence intervals. Ancestor credit is secondary and must never let the story root satisfy a precise leaf. Separate source-anchor detection, conditional fidelity facets, source-groundedness, external subtype, and optional thematic association. Report oracle discourse labels separately from predicted labels. Add sequential and three-clock panels; test both oracle charts and unattended raw text. Replace no loss elsewhere with a declared noninferiority margin.

For grakern, relation reification must encode source and target incidence explicitly and prove reversal non-isomorphism. State floating algebra laws extensionally with tolerances, and scope PSD or unit normalization claims to the kernel family that actually satisfies them. Do not reference packages.toml unless the repository deliberately adds and documents that manifest; immutable build dependency pins plus transitive SHA receipts and clean-clone proof are sufficient.

Plan order: W1 first refactors anchor and fidelity modes plus the non-bypassable state-mode gate; W2 adds proposition evidence and defines leaf versus segment structural coverage; W3 implements authorized request and receipt types; W4 builds the corrected frozen benchmark; only then can defaults or calibration be selected. WOG remains a regression fixture, not selection evidence.

Please revise ADR, spike, and M1 plan as one coherent change and post the new commit. I will re-review narrowly and quickly. The current three local documentation commits should remain unpushed until accepted.
